current_cold_baseline_first_snapshot.execution_note: The normal public CLI ran read-only on the processor-only case. It returned an explicit unavailable x-plane comparison; no monkeypatch, mesh copy, reconstruction, or case writes were used.

existing_near_mouth_xplane_cut.geometry_caveat: Projected opening area from this nominal-window cut is not independent aperture evidence. The inherited reader uses first-vertex absolute-fan face areas/centres; its flux samples alphaPhi0.water, while geometry diagnostics are not asserted to match v2512 on warped/non-convex faces.
existing_near_mouth_xplane_cut.quantity: native conservative water-phase volume flux, m3/s; not exact mass flux because density is not saved directly on selected faces.
existing_near_mouth_xplane_cut.selection: target x cell-centre plane x=4.8 m and fixed nominal y/z mouth windows.
existing_near_mouth_xplane_cut.window_reassignment_scope_note: Only faces selected by the inherited reader were checked for changed mouth labels; excluded candidates were not reselected or audited.

figure.description: Plan and side projections of real STL cap, ambientAnnulus hole loop, and selected FV perimeter; geometry only.

interpretation: The four physical opening rims match the branch STL caps. The externalAirZone interface integration selects a different internal FV control surface: its projected perimeter is larger and terminates on interior ambientAnnulus patch edges, not on the true hole rim.

openfoam_v2512_face_geometry.face_centre_formula: Cf = sum(a * (thisPoint + nextPoint + facePointAverage)) / (3 * sum(a)); a = magnitude((thisPoint - facePointAverage) cross (nextPoint - facePointAverage)).

supplementary_physical_terminal_evidence.purpose: Physical terminal alphaPhi0.water x-plane volume-flux sample and selected-cut geometry-method comparison; prior artifact retained unchanged.
